message.content:
{
  "title": "Give distinct wedding markets distinct landing-page context",
  "angle_statement": "When a wedding business serves regions with different visual expectations, a market-specific landing page can make the offer easier to evaluate than asking one page to represent both markets at once.",
  "audience": "Wedding photographers serving more than one region who are deciding how to focus advertising and landing-page content while managing a limited initial scope.",
  "reader_decision": "Check whether each target region has meaningfully different visual expectations or reasons to choose the business, then decide whether one page can represent them or whether to focus first on one market.",
  "reader_promise": "Leave with a practical page-context audit: identify the setting couples need to evaluate, check whether the imagery and offer represent it, and choose between retaining a shared page, focusing on a priority market, or considering a distinct page.",
  "positioning": "Warm · Lightbulb Moments / Education. Teach a scope decision before a page-building tactic; do not position this as a results case study.",
  "why_now": "Use the next advertising or landing-page planning decision as the editorial occasion, not a seasonal trend or a dated client event. The reported focus decision supplies the example, not evidence of present market demand [C2].",
  "core_insight": "Bounded inference: geographic focus and page context can be considered together. A distinct page may be useful when the buyer needs materially different imagery or offer context; a different location name alone is not the proposed criterion [C3].",
  "message_spine": [
    "Start with the buyer's setting, not the number of places the business serves: ask what the page must help this couple evaluate [C3].",
    "Use the reported regional imagery tension as an individual account, never as a rule about couples in either state [C1].",
    "Make an intentional initial scope choice; the reported Orlando focus and possible later Colorado targeting illustrate a decision, not a completed expansion [C2].",
    "Consider venue-specific context only as a bounded application of the regional principle, without promising a measured improvement [C4]."
  ],
  "audience_pain": "Editorial framing to validate, not a population finding: wanting to represent several markets while being unsure whether a shared page makes each setting clear. The supplied individual account reports this difficulty [C1].",
  "narrative": [
    "Hook direction: ask whether the page represents where this couple is considering getting married, rather than merely listing service areas.",
    "Problem: anonymously paraphrase the reported difficulty of using a shared page for visually different markets, subject to clearance [C1].",
    "Main point: introduce a context audit—setting, imagery, offer relevance—before discussing separate pages [C3].",
    "Decision: contrast retaining a coherent shared page with focusing first on a priority market; do not prescribe separate pages universally [C2, C3].",
    "Transformation: describe clearer editorial scope and a decision the reader can make, not higher conversion or better bookings.",
    "Invitation: bridge explicitly from regional context to the proposed venue-level application, then use the exact approved CTA [C4]."
  ],
  "evidence_boundaries": [
    "C1 and C2 are reported assertions from one discussion, not independently verified market research.",
    "Retain both original qualifications: the reasoning and decision are reported by the client; no comparison of page or campaign performance is supplied. The proposed Colorado expansion was a future possibility, not work shown as completed.",
    "Do not generalise the reported mountain preference to all Colorado or Florida couples.",
    "C3 is an inference; C4 is an untested venue-level application. Neither establishes a client-experience or performance gain.",
    "Speaker labels are unverified. Prefer anonymous paraphrase after consent review; do not invent a Whitney first-person conversation.",
    "Meeting date is unknown. Do not derive it from editorial-week admission or call the discussion recent.",
    "Evidence is not cleared for public use and sensitivity is unknown. Anonymous treatment does not itself establish permission.",
    "Prior arguments, exemplar briefs, brand examples and human approval provide editorial context only, not proof of current claims. External query prompts are not research findings.",
    "No quantitative outcomes are authorised. Structural slide numbering and deliverable counts are production requirements, not measured facts."
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim_id": "C1",
      "text": "In the reported discussion, the photographer connected difficulty targeting both markets through a shared landing page with their account of different desired imagery in Colorado and Florida.",
      "kind": "source_assertion",
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6"],
      "source_status": "reported",
      "qualifications": [
        "The reasoning and decision are reported by the client; no comparison of page or campaign performance is supplied.",
        "The proposed Colorado expansion was a future possibility, not work shown as completed.",
        "Speaker identity is unverified; do not generalise the account to all couples.",
        "Public use is false; sensitivity is unknown."
      ],
      "quote": "Shannon Lee: I think that's the plan, because I feel like it's hard to target both markets with one landing page, because a lot of my Colorado weddings want to see mountains, and a lot of my Florida weddings don't.",
      "public_quote": false,
      "numeric_facts": []
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C2",
      "text": "The reported plan was to focus on Orlando, with Colorado targeting described as a possible later step.",
      "kind": "source_assertion",
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_68f251d9b6451a5980967f0f", "ev_1b75c7c12a01d041ba7d8be4", "ev_3c51f6730a72932526534454"],
      "source_status": "reported",
      "qualifications": [
        "The reasoning and decision are reported by the client; no comparison of page or campaign performance is supplied.",
        "The proposed Colorado expansion was a future possibility, not work shown as completed.",
        "This is an intention in discussion, not proof of campaign launch or page completion.",
        "Speaker identity is unverified; meeting date is unknown.",
        "Public use is false; sensitivity is unknown."
      ],
      "quote": "Shannon Lee: try and target Colorado, but for now, we're just gonna go with Orlando.",
      "public_quote": false,
      "numeric_facts": []
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C3",
      "text": "A market-focused page may make imagery and offer context more coherent when the relevant visual expectations genuinely differ; focusing on a priority market is an option rather than a universal requirement.",
      "kind": "inference",
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6", "ev_3c51f6730a72932526534454"],
      "source_status": "inference from reported discussion; untested",
      "qualifications": [
        "No shared-page versus market-page comparison is supplied.",
        "Validate the difference for the business and audience rather than assume it from geography.",
        "A coherent shared page remains a possible choice.",
        "No performance or client-experience outcome is established."
      ],
      "quote": null,
      "public_quote": false,
      "numeric_facts": []
    },
    {
      "claim_id": "C4",
      "text": "Venue-specific landing-page context is a proposed application of the regional-context principle, not work or an improvement demonstrated in the supplied discussion.",
      "kind": "hypothesis",
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6"],
      "source_status": "bounded editorial application; untested",
      "qualifications": [
        "The evidence concerns regional imagery, not a venue-page comparison.",
        "The exact approved CTA expresses a direction; its better-client-experience wording must not be presented as a measured result.",
        "Use only truthful, cleared venue details and imagery if a venue example is later selected.",
        "Do not prescribe a page for every venue."
      ],
      "quote": null,
      "public_quote": false,
      "numeric_facts": []
    }
  ],
  "differentiation": "Keep the argument about geographic visual context and initial page scope. Do not drift into photography-style positioning, funnel-stage messaging, software affordability, or general acquisition-system claims.",
  "prior_differences": {
    "angle_0fbe8cc9cfffa8f9d70fdb6f": "Distinguish location imagery from candid-versus-guided coverage. Do not teach photography-style reassurance here.",
    "angle_9d5b915e1d67f035e55a6c6e": "Distinguish geographic context from audience decision stage. Do not turn the page audit into a cold-versus-retargeting message map.",
    "angle_7105aba8e326f02e56211c3f": "Ask readers to validate context differences, but do not develop a post-booking survey workflow or use review-versus-buying-trigger evidence.",
    "angle_d5e284128bd876fcc252938e": "Keep page representation separate from interpreting style search terms or deciding negative keywords.",
    "angle_9c2bc831fb61f8d994d439fc": "Treat focus as initial scope, not a diagnosis of spend without leads or a campaign-pause recommendation.",
    "angle_a19e2181f0c27e33e4b1fe9f": "Teach setting relevance, not a self-service pricing, availability or quote journey.",
    "angle_9a991eee30eae5e82fdee3d9": "Evaluate reader understanding without developing an email-open-versus-click lesson or booking attribution claim.",
    "angle_62fdf81e47a0c62d15a960d0": "Do not substitute a personalised pre-tour preview for this landing-page context decision.",
    "angle_7c73eebf6cca3612458cd575": "Discuss market priority without recommending channel budget splits or a spend reset.",
    "angle_b8d9b3f43299c825040d7812": "Compare contextual fit, not all-inclusive versus venue-only costs or package inclusions.",
    "angle_d745e4ebad2bc0287e9a7087": "Respect limited scope without importing software pricing, subscription objections or affordability thresholds.",
    "exemplar_buyer_stage": "Borrow differentiated format roles only; avoid testimonial placement and discovery-versus-consideration framing.",
    "exemplar_human_automation": "Borrow clear conceptual diagrams and implementation questions only; omit automation triggers, migration and product claims."
  },
  "voice": [
    "Apply the reviewed hierarchy: Founder Voice Guide governs voice; Knowledge Base supports examples; Savannah supplies framework without overriding tone.",
    "Use calm, warm curiosity. Explain why context matters before proposing page tactics.",
    "Help the reader reach a conditional decision rather than declaring shared pages wrong.",
    "Use plain wedding-business language, varied sentence rhythm and restrained emphasis.",
    "Avoid hype, blame, invented anecdotes, historical results and unconfirmed offer terms.",
    "Earn the exact CTA through the bounded venue-level bridge; do not replace it with exemplar invitations."
  ],
  "email": {
    "reader_job": "Choose an initial market and decide whether the current shared page represents its relevant context.",
    "direction": "A reflective founder email organised around scope, not a success story. Use an anonymous reported example only after clearance. Offer a conditional page audit rather than a compulsory rebuild.",
    "outline": [
      "Open with a question about whether the page helps a couple evaluate their intended setting.",
      "Paraphrase the individual regional imagery tension, retaining its reported status [C1].",
      "Explain the inference: check meaningful differences in imagery and reasons to choose, rather than changing a location heading alone [C3].",
      "Present the reported Orlando-first intention and possible later Colorado targeting without implying implementation [C2].",
      "Give the reader a retain / focus / consider-distinct-context decision prompt.",
      "Label venue-specific context as an application to consider, then close with the exact CTA [C4]."
    ],
    "evidence_ids": ["ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6", "ev_1b75c7c12a01d041ba7d8be4", "ev_3c51f6730a72932526534454"]
  },
  "carousel_reader_job": "Audit the context a landing page represents and select a defensible scope decision.",
  "carousel": [
    {
      "number": 1,
      "direction": "Hook question: does this page represent the setting this couple is evaluating? Use a neutral page outline, not a performance claim [C3].",
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6"]
    },
    {
      "number": 2,
      "direction": "Introduce the anonymous, reported shared-page tension after clearance. Label it an individual account, not regional research [C1].",
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6"]
    },
    {
      "number": 3,
      "direction": "Audit prompt: identify the intended setting and visual expectations. Show blank fields rather than asserted regional stereotypes [C3].",
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6"]
    },
    {
      "number": 4,
      "direction": "Audit prompt: check whether imagery and offer context help evaluate that setting. Label the relevance mechanism an inference [C3].",
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6"]
    },
    {
      "number": 5,
      "direction": "Decision branch: retain a shared page if it can represent the relevant contexts coherently. Do not frame separate pages as mandatory [C3].",
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6"]
    },
    {
      "number": 6,
      "direction": "Alternative branch: focus first on a priority market. Reference the reported Orlando intention and later Colorado possibility, not completed campaigns [C2].",
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_3c51f6730a72932526534454", "ev_1b75c7c12a01d041ba7d8be4"]
    },
    {
      "number": 7,
      "direction": "Extend cautiously to venue context: ask whether a specific setting warrants distinct imagery or explanation. Label this proposed application untested [C4].",
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6"]
    },
    {
      "number": 8,
      "direction": "Close with the exact approved CTA. Include an adjacent caveat that venue-level tailoring is a proposed application, not a measured client-experience result [C4].",
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6"]
    }
  ],
  "reels": [
    {
      "reader_job": "Recognise when geographic coverage and visual context are different page-design questions.",
      "direction": "Founder-led conceptual reframe with an illustrative shared-page diagram. No client screenshots or stereotyped regional image montage.",
      "outline": [
        "Ask whether listing a service area is the same as representing its setting.",
        "Use the reported imagery tension anonymously after clearance [C1].",
        "Explain the conditional relevance inference, not a conversion result [C3].",
        "Bridge to venue context as untested and use the exact CTA [C4]."
      ],
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6"]
    },
    {
      "reader_job": "Choose a manageable initial market focus without treating future expansion as completed work.",
      "direction": "A scope-decision reel using a priority-now / possible-later diagram. Keep it separate from budget optimisation.",
      "outline": [
        "Open with the reader's choice of what the initial page needs to represent.",
        "Describe the reported Orlando-first intention [C2].",
        "Mark Colorado targeting as a possible later step, not a rollout.",
        "Ask the reader to select the context they can represent truthfully now; close through the bounded venue bridge and exact CTA [C4]."
      ],
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_1b75c7c12a01d041ba7d8be4", "ev_3c51f6730a72932526534454", "ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6"]
    },
    {
      "reader_job": "Decide whether venue-specific context is worth considering rather than automatically creating pages for every venue.",
      "direction": "A blank context-audit demonstration. Present venue tailoring as a hypothesis; do not invent a named venue, customer preference or winning page.",
      "outline": [
        "Ask what would actually differ beyond the venue name.",
        "Show prompts for relevant imagery, setting and offer explanation [C4].",
        "Keep a shared page as an option when no meaningful distinction is established [C3].",
        "State that no venue-page outcome comparison is supplied, then use the exact approved CTA [C4]."
      ],
      "evidence_ids": ["ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6"]
    }
  ],
  "cta": {
    "text": "Match the landing page per venue for a better client experience."
  },
  "creative_direction": [
    "Use restrained editorial layouts, generous spacing and simple decision diagrams; verify visual specifications against the current brand kit before production.",
    "Use founder footage and illustrative page cards labelled as concepts. Do not depict a live build, launch or before-and-after result.",
    "Prefer blank audit fields over invented venue facts. Obtain asset rights and factual review before adding real wedding imagery.",
    "Keep reported account, inference and proposed application visually distinguishable with text labels.",
    "Vary openings and demonstrations across formats while preserving the same approved CTA."
  ],
  "accessibility": [
    "Provide accurate captions for reels and readable on-screen text within platform safe areas.",
    "Use adequate contrast and text labels rather than colour alone for decision branches.",
    "Write carousel alt text explaining each audit step and the distinction between reported account and untested application.",
    "Keep caveats readable and available in spoken or accompanying text; do not hide them in tiny footnotes."
  ],
  "distribution": [
    "Proposed sequence: founder email for the scope decision, Instagram carousel for the audit, then reels for recognition, prioritisation and venue-level application.",
    "Consider TikTok adaptations only after platform and clearance review; preserve qualifications in each standalone version.",
    "Do not add a booking link, offer, DM keyword or automated destination. None is part of the locked CTA.",
    "Keep production preparation, brief approval, asset approval, scheduling and publication as separate states."
  ],
  "evaluation_signals": [
    "Assess whether readers can identify a meaningful context difference rather than simply name another region.",
    "Review replies or comments for a reasoned retain / focus / distinct-page decision.",
    "Use saves and viewing engagement as secondary content signals, not evidence that location-specific pages improve bookings.",
    "If a future page comparison is proposed, define its measurement and attribution separately; this brief supplies no baseline or outcome."
  ],
  "similarity_review": "Treat supplied prior arguments as editorial comparison material only. Semantic and lexical review is recorded in the dossier, but legacy publication coverage is incomplete because the legacy catalogue is missing. Do not claim publication novelty or a fully checked recent archive. Pending prior angles and prepared exemplar briefs are not published assets; generated, approved, scheduled and published remain distinct states. The intended distinction is geographic visual context plus initial scope, with venue specificity clearly marked as a bounded application.",
  "claims_requiring_consent": [
    "C1 and C2: permission to publicly reference the discussion anonymously remains unresolved; public_use is false and sensitivity is unknown.",
    "Any named attribution or exact quotation requires verified speaker identity and explicit public-use clearance. Default to no public quotes.",
    "Client identity, page screenshots, portfolio images, account details and venue assets require separate permission and rights review if selected.",
    "Approval of the angle and exact CTA does not establish consent to publish source material."
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    {
      "question_id": "Q1",
      "text": "May the reported regional discussion be paraphrased anonymously in public content, and who can grant that permission?",
      "required": true,
      "answer": null
    },
    {
      "question_id": "Q2",
      "text": "Can source review confirm the speaker's role and context without relying on transcript labels?",
      "required": true,
      "answer": null
    },
    {
      "question_id": "Q3",
      "text": "Does the approver accept the explicit untested venue-level bridge and caveat alongside the exact locked CTA?",
      "required": true,
      "answer": null
    },
    {
      "question_id": "Q4",
      "text": "Can the missing legacy publication catalogue be checked for overlapping market- or venue-context arguments?",
      "required": true,
      "answer": null
    },
    {
      "question_id": "Q5",
      "text": "Should production remain diagram-only, or is there a cleared, fact-checked venue asset suitable for illustration?",
      "required": false,
      "answer": null
    }
  ],
  "sources": [
    "Primary original source: transcript_9e1879c15e05bd2d327366bf, Carmen Cruickshank's Personal Meeting Room's transcript (3).txt; source hash 5c79276bf75415f1a4742b4dc1f7501a53bfe93cffd88d602fb07670554d36cf. Meeting date and source URL not supplied.",
    "C1 grounding: ev_e2358d95913b781d409db5c6, original passage zoom:86678f3ddc1adcf1:span:230.",
    "C2 grounding: ev_68f251d9b6451a5980967f0f, ev_1b75c7c12a01d041ba7d8be4 and ev_3c51f6730a72932526534454, original passages span:229, span:233 and span:234.",
    "Remaining supplied passages are same-discussion context and acknowledgments, not independent corroboration.",
    "Reviewed brand bundle: Founder Voice Guide, supporting Knowledge Base and Strategy from WLF Savannah. Use for editorial direction only.",
    "Approved angle angle_ab0db137df928ed4e835dfda and exact CTA: locked editorial assignment, not independent factual evidence.",
    "Supplied prior arguments and buyer-stage / human-automation exemplars: differentiation and structure only.",
    "Dossier coverage and gaps: incomplete legacy publication catalogue; external research disabled; query prompts supply no findings."
  ],
  "handoff_checklist": [
    "Preserve angle_statement, audience, reader_decision and cta exactly.",
    "Resolve required questions before approval; no unanswered required question is silently waived.",
    "Verify every factual asset statement against C1–C4 and original evidence IDs; retain reported status and qualifications.",
    "Use no numeric outcome without a structured NumericFact tied to one exact original source quote.",
    "Keep the regional example individual and the venue application hypothetical; omit measured-improvement language.",
    "Obtain consent and rights before using source paraphrases, identities, quotes or real assets.",
    "Check all format roles remain distinct and the carousel contains the specified complete slide sequence.",
    "Apply the reviewed voice hierarchy and accessibility checks.",
    "Complete publication similarity review or record its remaining limitation explicitly.",
    "Record brief approval, public-use clearance, asset approval, scheduling and publication separately. This handoff neither authorises publication nor promises downstream generation."
  ]
